blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي مرسلا مشكوة المصابيح رقم:٥٠٨٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “The people of Iman, those who most fulfil the commands of Allah Ta'ala, are also of very gentle disposition. Just as a camel that obeys its herder goes wherever it is led, and sits down if it is made to sit on a rock, so too are the people of Iman” — Hazrat Makhul (RH) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Sitting on a rock is a very difficult thing for a camel, yet it obeys its master's command and sits on it.
(Majma' Bihar al-Anwar)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُوْدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلَا اُخْبِرُكُمْ بِمَنْ يَحْرُمُ عَلَي النَّارِ، وَبِمَنْ تَحْرُمُ عَلَيْهِ النَّارُ؟ عَلَي كُلِّ قَرِيْبٍ هَيِّنٍ سَهْلٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب فضل كل قريب هين سهل رقم:٢٤٨٨
blocks.tamil_translation: “Shall I tell you for whom entering Jahannam is haram, and whom it is haram for Jahannam to touch? Listen carefully: it is made haram for the fire of Jahannam to touch everyone who is close to people, of very gentle disposition and soft nature” — Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of 'one who is close to people' is that because of his gentle disposition he mixes a great deal with people, and because of his good manners people too associate with him with affection, without any hesitation.
(Ma'ariful Hadith)
